text:
Harper (Finance): Heads-up: summer procurement bulletin posted. Small policy clarifications + a temporary emergency spend path for customer-impacting infra. Short version below.

Liam (Infra): Short version please :eyes: we9re mid-deploy.

Harper (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Temporary single-invoice/card approval raised to $6,000 through 2026-09-30 for ops-critical spend. 2) Emergency cloud vendor exception form for quota/patch/incident work (fast-track). 3) Contractors still require PO for > $2,000. 4) Client meals require itemized receipt + brief purpose.

Zoe (Sales): Is the $6k retroactive to invoices from this week? We had a demo rack charge on Mon.

Harper (Finance): Applies to invoices dated >= today. If already submitted, add comment "proc-priority" in the invoice portal and Purchasing will expedite.

Ravi (Purchasing): Fast-track flow: fill https://intranet/redwood/finance/exception, include project ID, est. spend, incident ticket, tag @Priya. Purchasing triage within 2 business hours; Finance signs off for <= $6k. >$6k goes to Director review.

Priya (Finance Partner): Note: attach vendor quote and a one-paragraph justification. Incomplete submissions will be deprioritized.

Liam (Infra): For short-term GPU rentals under emergency, exception alone ok? or need PO too?

Ravi (Purchasing): Exception covers ad-hoc infra rentals up to $6k; Purchasing will create a PO in parallel if needed. If expected >$6k, open a PO and reference the exception ID.

procurement-bot: New exception submitted #5120 (liam.infra). Attachments: gpu-rental-quote.pdf. ETA triage: ~1h.

Liam (Infra): Uploaded the quote + incident link. Thanks.

Harper (Finance): Operational notes: (a) This $6k bump is temporary and reviewed end of quarter. (b) Enterprise vendor onboarding remains unchanged. (c) Weekly 15-min office hours for procurement questions on Fridays 10am PT.

Zoe (Sales): Can we get a 1-page checklist for runbooks?

Harper (Finance): Yes 1 I'll post a checklist and the exception form link in #docs and on the intranet. Also running a quick Q&A Friday.

Priya (Finance Partner): Reminder: client entertainment still needs itemized receipts even if paid on company card; pre-clear larger meals when possible.

Harper (Finance): Thanks everyone. If you have active exceptions affecting customers, ping @Ravi or me and mark the form "ops-emergency" so we prioritize.
